text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Alright, not bad, not bad at all! Ha-ha, 
glad I took a break, even if I had to 
force myself!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Sh-Shakur-senpai seems to be in a good 
mood, doesn't he...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
“Still... seeing her smile like that is 
beyond weird... it's, it's terrifying...!”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The shoe on your horseshoe is about to 
fall off. You'd better watch out, wouldn't 
ya say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The surrounding Umamusume are entranced by 
the unexpected sight of a good-humored Air 
Shakur... At any rate, it seems she got 
plenty of rest!
